text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing with Daiwa Scarlet,
we stopped by the shopping district. And then—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is it just me,
or is it more crowded than usual...?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah. The lottery is today.
Maybe I'll go ahead and use that, then.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. A friend gave me
a raffle ticket the other day.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"As thanks for always helping with my homework," she said.
Hehe, even though it's the natural thing to do.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And with that, I'm gonna go draw right away. There's no point in just holding onto the tickets, after all.

"Then, we joined the line, and I watched over
Daiwa Scarlet as she spun the raffle wheel."
And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh, the grand prize!?
A hot springs trip!? Woohoo!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! As expected of me!
To think I'm even number one in luck among Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Now then, when should I go, I wonder...
The expiration date... seems to be pretty far off, though.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Right.
Maybe I should leave it for a little longer."
choice_data_list: You're not going to use it now?
Aren't you going to use it now?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes. After all, we're right in the middle of an important season.
It's still too early for either of us to relax and take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Since we have the chance, I'd like to take things super easy...
and let them relax to the fullest, too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
“......Dummy.
Are you being serious right now?”

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Anyway!
It just means it's not my turn yet!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hold onto this for now, will you?
I feel like I'll be tempted every time I look at it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but absolutely do not use it without asking, okay?!
I'm the one who won it! Got it?!

And so, with Daiwa Scarlet practically shoving it into my hands,
I ended up holding onto the hot spring trip ticket.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, not bad at all!
It's got the number "1" attached to it too♪
choice_data_list: The hamburger steak looks delicious too

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, you. Are you hungry?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll give you my Salisbury steak.
I've got dorm food anyway.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey, at times like this, why don't you just
honestly say you want to eat a hamburger steak?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm not bad at cooking.
I can whip up a hamburger steak whenever I want.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Just ask, would you?
It's not like I wouldn't listen to you once in a while.

Even so, it's a delicious-looking hamburger steak.
I really want Daiwa Scarlet to eat some too...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. If you're fine with that, then whatever.

And on that day, I ate carrot hamburg steak
together with Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: S-Second... place...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"No! I hate 2nd place, and I hate 2nd prize!!
Actually, I just hate the sound of the word 'two'!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer!
Don't you have any lottery tickets!?
choice_data_list: Even if you tell me that...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No complaining! You've gotta have at least one!
Turn out all your pockets, too!!

"And after having my entire body thoroughly checked,
Daiwa Scarlet finally
let me go..."

"...That being said, 2nd place—no,
the carrots did nothing wrong."
I think I'll come up with a nutritional supplement menu for Daiwa Scarlet next time, making good use of carrots—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haa, is that all it was?
Well, hitting the target at all is a good result, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Only one carrot, though...
Hmm, what should I make...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Since she gave me a raffle ticket,
I wanted to give her something in return.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm an honor student, after all. Courtesy demands I repay courtesy, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, maybe I'll go with the carrot cake.
...If I recall correctly, they didn't dislike sweets.

And after finishing her shopping,
Daiwa Scarlet returned to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah... well, that's normally how it goes.
I know that's just the way things are, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hearing 'You lose' straight to my face makes me a bit ticked off...!!

"...I have to make sure this anger doesn't explode.
Carrying that sense of duty, I returned to the academy with her."
